hook: I BULLIED THE JANITOR. THEN THIS.

lines.text: The old janitor everyone laughed at paid for my senior trip... and I was the one throwing grapes at him.

image.prompt: {kyle} sitting alone on a wooden bench in a sunny school courtyard holding an envelope, emotional teary eyes, golden afternoon light

lines.text: His name was Mr. Banks. He ate lunch alone on the same bench every day.

image.prompt: {banks} sitting alone on a wooden bench in a school courtyard eating a sandwich from a brown paper bag, peaceful, students in the blurry background

lines.text: My friends and I threw grapes at him from the cafeteria window. Every single day.

image.prompt: {kyle} and {grapes} laughing and leaning out of a school cafeteria window, mischievous grins, bright cafeteria

lines.text: He never said a word. He just swept them up.

image.prompt: {banks} quietly sweeping the school hallway floor with a broom, calm humble expression, long hallway with blue lockers

lines.text: Then my mom lost her job.

image.prompt: {mom} sitting at a small kitchen table at night looking at bills with a worried face, {kyle} watching from the doorway, warm dim lamp light

lines.label: THAT FALL

lines.text: The senior trip cost two hundred dollars. We didn't have twenty.

image.prompt: {kyle} holding an empty open wallet with a sad face in a school hallway, other students excitedly walking past

lines.text: I sat outside the office and cried where I thought nobody could see.

image.prompt: {kyle} sitting on a chair outside a school office with his head down, a tear on his cheek, empty hallway

lines.text: Monday morning, the office called me in. My trip was paid. In full.

image.prompt: {kyle} in a school office looking shocked and confused, jaw dropped, a kind secretary smiling behind a desk

lines.label: MONDAY

lines.text: No name. Just an envelope... with a little banana sticker on it.

lines.text: I ran to his bench. He was eating his lunch like always.

lines.text: He looked up, smiled, and said... 'Pick up your grapes, kid.'

lines.text: I eat lunch on that bench every day now. Because the old janitor everyone laughed at...
